imgconv - convert images between formats

Usage:
  imgconv [options] <input> [<output>]

Options:
  -o <file>          write the result to <file> (default: stdout)
  -q, --quality <n>  JPEG quality, 1-100
  --format <fmt>     output format: png | jpg | webp
  -s, --strip        remove metadata
  --resize <WxH>     resize before converting, e.g. 800x600
  -v                 verbose; repeat for more (-vv)
  -h, --help         show this help
